description:
Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add: dedicated coverage-upper handoff after implementation and technical review, using the actual restacked PR6 changed-file set and fresh reports. Coverage tests may extend focused test files; production changes discovered here require normal review again. No commit, push, merge or PR publication without later explicit authorization.
Tests to add before implementation: follow coverage-upper skill for uncovered changed behavior with meaningful tests; avoid mirror tests, internal mocks, global mutation and weakened assertions. Preserve approved current contracts; any existing test behavior change still needs specific human approval. Validate coverage-phase changes and review them before finalization. Numerical targets belong to the skill, not each implementation issue.
Branches/paths validated: changed security/lifecycle/Action/alias/propagation branches and intended exceptions/follow-ups; effective environment/parent/source freshness; no unresolved test failures or PR5/PR7 drift. Run final mix precommit per docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md before requesting final human approval, and record exact commands/results/limitations. Current planning-only work has run no application tests and is not evidence of implementation completion.
Mocking plan: reuse isolated real-boundary tests and external-edge stubs only; preserve test-state ownership.
Documentations to update for both code and docs/ related content: coverage exceptions/follow-up issues, final validation evidence and actual parent boundary in Beadwork; later authorized PR description includes evidence and scope. No copied workflow checklist in service docs.
Action reuse assessment: verification-only, no new executable operation; recheck final source for unplanned helpers/parallel authorization/selection/delivery paths. Final technical/coverage approval never self-approves human acceptance or authorizes Git publication.

Implementation constraints: This is a proposed plan only. The current request authorizes setup and Beadwork planning, not implementation, commits, pushes, rebases or publication. Read AGENTS.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/documentation.md, docs/conventions.md and docs/code-quality.md before later execution; read the owning service guide and each touched module's @moduledoc. Agent work also follows docs/services/agent.md#harness-critical-checks-for-coding-agents. Recheck live source/contracts after PR5 advances. Preserve existing test behavior; if an assertion/scenario must change, record old/proposed behavior and obtain specific human approval first. No such changes are approved here. New unit/integration/property tests are immediate and written before production code. Keep real internal boundaries and isolated fixture/process state; inject runtime dependencies through established opts/context and Zaq.Config.get/4 where relevant, without global configuration mutation. Follow the authoritative validation lifecycle in docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md; do not treat historical/reference runs as current validation. PR5 owns delivery execution/outcomes; PR7 owns RunAgent, NotifyPerson and notification/workflow integration.
title: Run post-review coverage and final validation for PR6
